name: Shree Securities Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Shree Securities Ltd 
is in the business of investing and financing
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
Company is a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking NBFC providing:
a) Investment in listed & unlisted shares/securities
b) Long term and short term investment 
c) Providing Loans to individuals and corporates
d) Financial and Investment Consultancy

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.13% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -26.2% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -30.2%
